periods.time: Three days after capture at the Tatra US base
periods.location: US base in Czechoslovakia near the Tatra Mountains
periods.summary: Arlanz and Abraham try to break Tsukikage and Kazamatsuri so they will testify that the League and Japan manipulated Rebellion. Abraham's mind control fails against their will, so Arlanz explains the United States' goal of becoming world justice and his own desire for unrestricted human experiments. He then tortures Rinna and Sara with fantasy-form pyrokinesis, forcing Kazamatsuri to yield, but Tsukikage refuses to betray Japan.
periods.cause: The US needs convincing witnesses to frame the League and Japan as the evil behind Rebellion and justify a world war.
periods.process: Abraham repeatedly uses Mind Control while Arlanz mocks the captives. Tsukikage asks why the US wants war; Arlanz describes a world where US will becomes justice and admits he wants experimental subjects. He offers protection for the men's families if they cooperate. When Tsukikage spits on him, Arlanz mutates Tsukikage's ear and displays Rinna and Sara bound in another room. PSYON soldiers burn the girls with fantasy-form fire until Kazamatsuri breaks, but Tsukikage refuses as prime minister.
periods.outcome: The coercion continues until Ouma's attack interrupts the torture. Tsukikage remains politically unbroken, while Kazamatsuri is devastated by his daughter's suffering.
periods.significance: Clarifies the Union/US war ideology and Arlanz's personal research motive while establishing Tsukikage's refusal to sell out Japan.
